title: The objective is worthwhile empire benefit, not Quarter count
statement: The confirmed CSC AI objective is competent, worthwhile supply-chain development supporting empire priorities; site scores, Quarter counts and Service flags are intermediate indicators.
scope: Henno's confirmed design objective, 28 October 2026, across Basic assistance and RH compatibility; not a demonstrated capability.
limits: The objective does not prescribe final coefficients or prove any tested package meets it.

title: Recent screens did not establish overall AI improvement
statement: The selective RH screen reduced acquisition spending 195 versus 795 Gold but reached 3 versus 4 full-supply contexts; customer-aware v2 then reached 2 versus 3 contexts and 15 versus 19 working Base sites. These joint-package same-map observations do not establish isolated component causality or overall sustained benefit.
scope: The closed turn 150 reference/selective/customer-aware RH comparisons reported 1 November 2026; matched metrics retain their original definitions.
limits: One scenario, multiple changed inputs, cohort/age differences, observation gaps and late right-censored investment; partial benefits were not measured as causal profit.

title: Evidence stages and partial benefits must remain distinct
statement: Input loading, native value delivery, proposal, selection, execution, completion, retained supply and empire benefit are distinct evidence stages. Full-supply milestone absence does not establish zero partial return; links and Service flags are not measured payments.
scope: Cross-study interpretation framework grounded in native consumer/queue observations and CSC classifier definitions.
limits: This is a measurement rule; it does not supply missing financial observations or causal estimates.

title: The older optimisation campaign remains paused
statement: The broad optimisation campaign was paused; both November placement observers closed without a useful target choice or weight change. Later IZ/district investigations were separately authorised scopes, not campaign resumption.
scope: Research-status reconciliation as of 3 November 2026; historical phase instructions are not current work orders.
limits: This records project research state, not a fresh process inventory or authorisation to launch tests.

title: Final closure supersedes historical live instructions
statement: Dated reports and old automation messages preserve preparation, live, repair and closure phases; final status and explicit later corrections govern their interpretation. A historical next-step or heartbeat is not an instruction to restart closed work.
scope: AI optimisation chat and dated CSC AI reports through 3 November 2026.
limits: A later date alone does not invalidate earlier evidence; corrections must identify the affected assertion or scope.

title: Withdraw the old PLAYER_PLOT city-enumeration mapping
statement: The prior PLAYER_PLOT_YIELDS city-iterator mapping was incorrect. PLAYER_PLOT_YIELDS and SINGLE_PLOT_YIELDS share a once-only supplied-plot handler that neither enumerates plots nor fills the required pointer; inspected direct top-level contexts leave it empty.
scope: Windows XP2 DLL SHA-256 324c51e9ea3531758842e16c69e6cddbefbb226c5b675c3d6e60111646c2e98c; specific direct DistrictValue and ordinary non-placement building paths.
limits: Not a universal zero-effect claim for placement-specific, nested, live gameplay or other contexts.

title: Hidden private yields are not automatically human-inert
statement: An ordinary custom yield can affect citizen allocation and economic output; hiding its UI does not establish AI-only delivery or economic isolation. Older inert-human-output wording is superseded.
scope: Private-resource citizen experiments and the traced dynamic ordinary-yield consumer; exact role/profile gates remain source-specific.
limits: Does not claim every private signal leaks in every current profile or quantify each indirect economic effect.

title: The placement observers failed measurement cost, not incentive efficacy
statement: Both unchanged-weight placement diagnostics stopped at turn 2 after callback volumes exceeded their cost gate; neither captured a useful target Quarter decision. They establish no response/non-response or calibrated weight effect.
scope: The two closed 1 November 2026 native Quarter placement diagnostics; one AI interval each, no host economic effects.
limits: Static score-route findings remain valid separately. A future observation requires affordable filtering and its own scoped protocol.

title: A customer-space promise is not a native reservation
statement: The customer-aware planner's future-customer bookkeeping does not prevent competing native district use; a promised Holy Site plot became a Theater Square. Geometry and named plans do not ensure customer construction.
scope: Customer-aware v2 pilot and its planner implementation; distinguishes internal promise tracking from native reservation/production APIs.
limits: Does not establish that every future promise fails or that explicit native reservation is impossible through all interfaces.

title: Later diagnostic startups close the v2 helper startup question
statement: The v2 report's pending cold-start validation was later superseded at the capability level: both placement diagnostic cold startups verified the required captured UI modules, versions and methods without manual imports.
scope: Later 1 November 2026 diagnostic startup gates after promoted UI helper initialization repairs.
limits: Proves startup capability, not a positive planner candidate, useful placement decision capture or improved chain outcome.

title: Reconcile evidence against its executed build and source version
statement: Recovered names/layouts, current source and historical executed packages must remain distinct. Binary identity and body checks ground native claims; later source repairs do not retroactively describe an earlier game's execution.
scope: Cross-study evidence practice, including symbol aliases, source promotions and archived executed text.
limits: This practice cannot recover missing observations or prove instrumentation neutrality; unresolved context remains explicit.

title: Arbitrary native district incentives remain a design question
statement: General author-defined district incentives still need policy, lifecycle and release integration. A fixed single-entry native prototype now has isolated Win64 checks and measured nonzero delivery through cache, winner score, present value and a new request's logged value; request priority remains distinct.
scope: Implementation opportunity inferred from inspected district-scoring/cache/request architecture as of 3 November 2026.
limits: The fixed prototype does not establish a general numerical Lua callback, native generation tracking, arbitrary policy publication or release compatibility. Game delivery, changed choice, construction and economic benefit require distinct evidence.
